title: Tower Gazebo — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete small timber tower gazebo: four tall exposed posts, open raised square platform, steep stair with separate treads/stringers/handrails, vertical platform balusters with a real stair entry, bracing and green pyramidal sheet-metal roof with underside rafters. Shared wood_plain and metal_standing_seam graphs, four authored LODs and no private texture atlas, copied photograph pixels or attached tree geometry. Hidden joinery and exact scale remain original photo-led approximations.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Named Беседка-вышка node6338741862 at unchanged assigned anchor[37.53197110790589,54.07432543327198]. No retained building footprint within40m. LocalX southeast, localZ southwest toward the nearest retained path point6.897m away; native axes baked with heading0. Stair faces the inferred approach, with30-degree orientation uncertainty.
